text:
incident-bot: Pager — HIGH_ERROR_RATE on muirbank-prod (VPC dedicated pool: muirbank-dedicated-1). 5xxs spike, latency spike, auto-scale failing :rotating_light:
oncall_jamie: on it. jumping into metrics & logs now
sre_avi: I'm seeing GPU queue length at 98% on pool muirbank-dedicated-1, lots of preemption/eviction events. OOMs in worker-3 around: `oom: alloc failed at step kv-cache`
eng_rita: model inference logs show repeated soft-failure from model v3.2.1 (tokenization mismatch errors) — fallback variant v3-safe exists.
solutions_micah: muirbank requested strict pinning for stability. They allow emergency safe-variant switch with PM approval only. Can we avoid a full redeploy?
cust_ops_emma: confirmed — MUIRBANK-SOC approved emergency fallback to verified safe variant for up to 2 hours. Please notify if behavior changes.
ops_lead_sam: good, record customer approval in incident log: approved by emma@muirbank at 11:12.
oncall_jamie: plan: 1) enable routing fallback to v3-safe for muirbank tenant via console (non-disruptive) 2) throttle new sessions to pool to reduce pressure 3) monitor error-rate & latency 4) if stable, roll forward pin for full tenant. any objections?
sre_avi: agree. quick check: KV cache growth correlated with session length — enabling prefix-KV eviction might free memory. I'll flip that concurrently.
eng_rita: to be safe, set the model pin override at tenant-level rather than pool-level: `PATCH /v1/tenants/muirbank/config {"model_pin":"v3-safe"}` — that avoids affecting other tenants on same pool.
oncall_jamie: executing now (console + API). pinging ops for approval of API call.
ops_lead_sam: go ahead. track with runbook step ID RB-39.
incident-bot: Deploybot: change queued: tenant-config-patch-1756789012 by oncall_jamie. CI checks OK.
oncall_jamie: patch applied. routing shows muirbank -> v3-safe (99% of new traffic). live error rate dropping from 14% -> 3% in last 90s. latency median down 12%. :thumbsup:
sre_avi: KV eviction enabled on workers. memory stabilized, no further OOMs. GPU queue length dropped to 40%.
eng_rita: logs: model v3-safe returning consistent outputs; some downstream post-process checks flagged token length differences for ~0.8% of responses — will add a small normalization patch but not blocking rollback.
cust_ops_emma: MuirBank SOC reports customer-facing errors decreased significantly. They want status updates every 30m and a post-incident summary.
solutions_micah: I'll draft the postmortem and the customer communication. note: need to document that muirbank has emergency fallback permission and the auth record.
oncall_jamie: handing off monitoring to sre_avi for next 30m. I will be available for escalation.
sre_avi: taking over monitoring. I'll escalate to eng_rita immediately if error rate >5% for 5m.
incident-bot: Note: incident severity set to SEV-2. Pager suppressed for this tenant while in fallback mode per policy.
ops_lead_sam: add follow-up tasks: - investigate cause of model v3.2.1 tokenization mismatch - test safe variant for parity - consider automated canary for tenant-level pins
oncall_jamie: thanks everyone. closing this thread for active mitigation. keeping incident open for postmortem.
eng_rita: uploading initial logs bundle to s3://redwood-incidents/muirbank/1756789012/logs.tar.gz
solutions_micah: ETA for postmortem draft ~3 hours. will @channel once ready.
